text: 10月22日，英伟达CEO黄仁勋在德国柏林举办的英伟达GPU技术大会期间表示，到2029年内存供应过剩的可能性不大，“内存的一个真正好处是，你总是可以用得更多”。当被问及是否考虑与中国长鑫存储合作时，黄仁勋回应提到，对此持开放态度。他表示：“我们与中国公司合作，几乎整个世界都在供应链的某个环节与中国公司合作。中国在底层基础设施技术方面非常出色，没有哪个国家在制造业方面比中国更强。”（央视财经）
text_en: On October 22, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said during the Nvidia GPU Technology Conference in Berlin, Germany, that memory oversupply is unlikely by 2029, and that "one of the really nice things about memory is you can always use more of it." When asked whether he would consider cooperating with China's ChangXin Memory Technologies, Huang responded that he is open to it. He said: "We work with Chinese companies; almost the whole world works with Chinese companies at some point in the supply chain. China is very good at underlying infrastructure technology, and no country is stronger than China in manufacturing." (CCTV Finance)
